prompt:
Goal: Create an ornate dark-fantasy anime event announcement poster for 覚醒の光, with the English subtitle “Light of Awakening,” themed around transforming the same original character through a more fitting magical light.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, richly detailed, midnight navy and gold color palette, glowing celestial atmosphere, elegant fantasy UI framing, high-resolution anime illustration style.

Layout: Divide the poster into three main zones. Top zone: exactly 3 tall arched stained-glass character panels arranged left, center, right. Middle zone: large title typography and mascot. Bottom zone: participation flow and event date information.

Top character panels: Show the same elegant anime girl in all 3 panels, preserving her pose, outfit, hairstyle, and overall identity while changing the lighting mood in each panel. She has long pale silver-blue hair, a dark bow or floral hair ornament, blue eyes, a black-and-white gothic fantasy dress with layered frills, translucent teal-black overskirt, gold chains and star ornaments, thigh-high white stockings, ornate black boots, small feathered wings, and an open book held in one hand. Count exactly 3 versions: left panel with divine pale sunlight streaming through a circular stained-glass halo; center panel with bright blue celestial awakening light, crystalline reflections, strongest glow, and elaborate gold frame; right panel with purple-blue moonlit stained glass and mystical shimmer. Each panel should have an ornate gold arch frame with star motifs and delicate filigree.

Middle zone: Place a cute chibi elf mascot at lower left of the title area. The mascot is a blonde female elf with long wavy hair, green eyes, pointed ears, cheerful open-mouth smile, dark adventurer outfit with gold accents, small boots, and explorer accessories. She holds a magnifying glass in one hand and a parchment/map in the other. To her right, place the huge glowing Japanese title 覚醒の光 in luminous white-gold serif calligraphy, with small sparkle symbols around it. Under it, place the English subtitle “Light of Awakening.” Below that, place the Japanese tagline 光が変われば、物語も変わる。 in glowing pale blue-white. Beneath the tagline, add a small gold-framed ribbon reading “同じプロンプト、違う雰囲気”.

Bottom flow section: Create exactly 3 rectangular framed cards in a row with arrows between them. Card 1 label: “元画像”; image: a small square portrait of a brown-haired gothic lolita anime girl with red roses in her hair. Card 2 label: “プロンプト”; image: a glowing white feather over a starry blue background. Card 3 label: “生成”; image: the same brown-haired girl transformed by warmer dramatic light. Add two gold arrows, one between card 1 and card 2, and one between card 2 and card 3. At the bottom left, show the hashtag #覚醒の光. At the bottom center, show the event period 8/13 18:00 – 8/16 23:59 JST in large gold-white serif text. On the lower right, add a small ornate plaque reading “GPT / Grok / Meta AI でテスト済み”.

Decorative elements: Count exactly these major decorative props: 3 large arched stained-glass frames at the top, 3 bottom instruction cards, 1 chibi elf mascot, 1 compass at lower right, 1 lantern near the right edge, 3 rolled parchment scrolls on the right side and lower right, multiple gold chains draped across the top and corners, starbursts, tiny constellations, crystal ornaments, and antique map fragments. Use lavish gold filigree borders around the entire poster.

Visual style: Ultra-detailed fantasy anime key visual, luminous magical lighting, polished gacha-game event banner aesthetic, ornate art nouveau frames, stained glass, celestial sparkles, deep shadows, radiant highlights, high contrast, elegant Japanese typography, premium poster design.

Constraints: Keep all text crisp and readable. Preserve the exact count of the 3 top character panels and 3 bottom flow cards. Do not add extra characters beyond the main repeated girl and the single chibi elf mascot. Avoid modern UI minimalism; the design should feel antique, magical, and ceremonial.

promptZh:
目标：为 覚醒の光 创建一张华丽的暗黑奇幻动漫活动公告海报，副标题为“Light of Awakening”，主题是通过更契合的魔法光影展现同一原创角色的蜕变。

画布：4:5 竖版海报，细节丰富，午夜蓝与金色配色，天体发光的氛围，优雅的奇幻 UI 边框，高分辨率动漫插画风格。

布局：将海报分为三个主要区域。顶部区域：精确排列 3 个高大的拱形彩色玻璃角色面板，分别位于左、中、右。中间区域：大型标题字体和吉祥物。底部区域：参与流程和活动日期信息。

顶部角色面板：在所有 3 个面板中展示同一位优雅的动漫少女，保持她的姿势、服装、发型和整体特征，同时改变每个面板的光影氛围。她留着长长的浅银蓝色头发，戴着深色蝴蝶结或花朵发饰，蓝色眼睛，身穿黑白哥特式奇幻连衣裙，带有层叠的褶边、半透明的青黑色罩裙、金链和星星装饰，穿着过膝白袜、华丽的黑色靴子，背部有小羽翼，手中拿着一本打开的书。精确展示 3 个版本：左侧面板为透过圆形彩色玻璃光环投射出的神圣苍白阳光；中间面板为明亮的蓝色天体觉醒之光，带有晶莹的反射、最强的光芒和精致的金框；右侧面板为紫蓝色月光下的彩色玻璃和神秘微光。每个面板都应有带有星星图案和精致花丝的华丽金色拱形框架。

中间区域：在标题区域的左下方放置一个可爱的 Q 版精灵吉祥物。吉祥物是一位金发女性精灵，留着长波浪卷发，绿色眼睛，尖耳朵，笑容灿烂，身穿带有金色装饰的深色冒险家服装，穿着小靴子，配有探险家配件。她一只手拿着放大镜，另一只手拿着羊皮纸/地图。在她的右侧，放置巨大的发光日文标题 覚醒の光，采用明亮的白金色衬线书法字体，周围环绕着小星星符号。下方放置英文副标题“Light of Awakening”。再下方放置日文标语 光が変われば、物語も変わる。，采用发光的淡蓝白色字体。在标语下方，添加一个写有“同じプロンプト、違う雰囲気”的小型金框丝带。

底部流程部分：创建 3 张精确的矩形边框卡片，横向排列，中间用箭头连接。卡片 1 标签：“元画像”；图片：一张棕发哥特萝莉动漫少女的小方形肖像，头发上别着红玫瑰。卡片 2 标签：“プロンプト”；图片：星空蓝色背景上的一根发光白羽毛。卡片 3 标签：“生成”；图片：同一位棕发少女在更温暖、更具戏剧性的光影下蜕变后的样子。添加两个金色箭头，一个在卡片 1 和卡片 2 之间，另一个在卡片 2 和卡片 3 之间。左下角显示标签 #覚醒の光。底部中心显示活动时间 8/13 18:00 – 8/16 23:59 JST，采用大型金白色衬线字体。右下角添加一块写有“GPT / Grok / Meta AI でテスト済み”的小型华丽铭牌。

装饰元素：精确包含以下主要装饰道具：顶部 3 个大型拱形彩色玻璃框架、底部 3 张说明卡片、1 个 Q 版精灵吉祥物、右下角 1 个指南针、右边缘附近 1 盏灯笼、右侧及右下方 3 卷羊皮纸卷轴、顶部和角落悬挂的多条金链、星爆、微型星座、水晶装饰和古地图碎片。在整张海报周围使用奢华的金色花丝边框。

视觉风格：超精细奇幻动漫主视觉图，发光的魔法光影，精致的抽卡游戏活动横幅美学，华丽的新艺术风格边框，彩色玻璃，天体闪光，深邃阴影，璀璨高光，高对比度，优雅的日文字体，高级海报设计。

约束：保持所有文字清晰易读。保留顶部 3 个角色面板和底部 3 张流程卡片的精确数量。除主要重复出现的少女和单个 Q 版精灵吉祥物外，不要添加额外角色。避免现代 UI 的极简主义；设计应具有古老、神秘和仪式感。
